method: Root visually inspected all 13 keyframes covering subtitle sections and MPC displays. Deliverables independently inspected the 13-frame contact sheet and GIF preview. Automated complete decode checked 3596 frames for blank rendering/caption pixels.
subtitle_check_limit: 13 caption sections visually sampled; pixel checks on all frames are heuristics, not a semantic full watch.
caption_timing_evidence: Planned captions in recording.js and sampled video frames. The on-stop precise caption-event timeline was not saved after an HTTP 400 size limit; no reconstructed actual caption timestamps are claimed. Shot, counterfactual and MPC events were recovered from memory and archived with hashes.
scope_limit: No physical-camera or actuator validation. Recorded replay is a synthetic 3D sensor dataset, distinct from the SAM video test.
